comparisonNormalization.purpose: comparison only; input and output document bytes remain unchanged
comparisonNormalization.whitespace: comparison lines and tokens use collapsed Unicode whitespace
comparisonNormalization.shortDocuments: documents with 3-49 words use the stricter short-document threshold; documents below 3 words are exempt and counted
comparisonNormalization.urlsCodeTables: not specially removed; they remain comparison content unless their complete short line is classified as corpus boilerplate

boilerplateControl.lineFingerprint: SHA-256 of NFKC-casefolded, whitespace-collapsed nonempty line
boilerplateControl.boilerplateLineDefinition: normalized line of at most 200 characters appearing in at least 25 distinct documents
boilerplateControl.coreDocument: comparison text after removing only lines meeting the frozen boilerplate definition
boilerplateControl.confirmedNearDuplicateRule: core-view exact Jaccard must meet the applicable threshold
boilerplateControl.boilerplateOnlyRule: whole-document Jaccard meets threshold but core-view Jaccard does not
boilerplateControl.emptyCoreBehavior: cannot confirm near duplication; may be reported as boilerplate-only if whole-document threshold is met

candidateGeneration.method: 64-component deterministic MinHash over unique 3-word shingles using SHA-256 shingle integers and fixed SHA-256-derived affine permutation coefficients modulo 2^61-1
candidateGeneration.candidatePairDefinition: unordered pair colliding in at least one band in either view
candidateGeneration.determinism: documents sorted by (sourceId, stableDocumentId); coefficients and band encoding fixed by policy version

verificationThresholds.justification: High thresholds target material whole-document redundancy rather than topical similarity. Under 16 bands of 4 rows, nominal LSH candidate probabilities at similarities 0.85 and 0.90 exceed 0.99999 and 0.999999 respectively; every candidate is then verified with exact set Jaccard.
verificationThresholds.exactJaccard: intersection size divided by union size of unique shingle sets

groupingAndSurvivor.grouping: connected components of confirmed near-duplicate pairs
groupingAndSurvivor.survivor: lexicographically smallest (sourceId, stableDocumentId) in each component
groupingAndSurvivor.crossSourceAndWithinSourceTreatment: same thresholds and survivor rule; report separately

requiredOutputValidation: no confirmed near-duplicate pair above frozen threshold
failClosed: candidate cap or bucket cap exceeded
output duplicate or confirmed violation remains
